input.question: Who is the artist of the album "Both Sides Now"?

documents.text: Both Sides Now (Elton John album) Both Sides Now is the fourth studio album by British singer Elton John. It is his first studio album since "Somewhere – The Songs of Sondheim and Bernstein" in 1994. He says the main reason for taking so long since his last album was that he was simply busy. “The thing is because I work in theatre it is all encompassing and all consuming.
